title: Introducing the Correlation Concentration Ratio (CCR): Quantitative Framework for Comparing Quantum Cluster States
summary: In this paper, numerical simulations of four-mode continuous-variable cluster states with different topologies in the framework of measurement-based quantum computation are presented. By utilizing the symplectic representation and covariance matrix, the process of generating cluster states with linear, square, and T-shaped topologies has been systematically modeled.
